ledger.read_scope: full history JSON parsed plus full legacy ledger

mechanism: At each V25 tier-1 shared-basis rebuild after the first, keep rank R_OLD and exactly one weighted-Gram application, but initialize the block with Omega = W_slice + Qp, where Qp is the transported previous old-source basis. The first join remains canonical V25. No fitting, target use, oversampling, extra Gram pass, response projection, or second estimator pass.

adjacent_but_distinct.distinction: Canonical V25 starts every tier-1 rebuild only from a fresh layer-weight slice; RSRF injects the transported prior basis into the same-width start block.
E022 widens the sketch to R_OLD+16 and performs an eigentruncation. RSRF keeps exactly R_OLD columns, no eigentruncation, and no oversampling.
QPASS changes the number of G applications. RSRF keeps one G application and changes only the initial block.
E094 factorizes across source index and was gated on source-axis numerical rank. RSRF does not compress the source axis; it changes the spatial range-finder start.
RSRF is target/response agnostic and uses no downstream observable or response direction.

explicit_exclusions: R232 DRRE / Richardson / rank extrapolation and descendants
